services.name: identity-access
services.title: Identity and access
services.scope: Tenant and environment enrollment, principal admission, owners, scoped grants, revocation and service identity
services.authority: Principal and membership lifecycle; authoritative current access receipts

services.name: estate-catalog
services.title: Estate catalog
services.scope: Customer journeys, services, protected agent profiles and versions, shared resources and authored relationships
services.authority: Inventory identity, accountable ownership and independently activated agent versions

services.name: integration
services.title: Connections and ingestion
services.scope: Connections, discovery, provider inventory receipts, signal intake, collection policies and scheduler leases
services.authority: Provider source bindings and collection checkpoints; never computes health from arrival time

services.name: evidence
services.title: Evidence and qualification
services.scope: Immutable observations, source attestations, classification, qualification policies, reviews and waivers
services.authority: Observation provenance and quality; stale or missing data remains explicitly unknown

services.name: objectives
services.title: Objectives and imports
services.scope: Versioned objective templates, mandatory rules, proposals, independent activation and imported objective resolution
services.authority: Approved desired outcomes and source-definition provenance; never fabricates measurements

services.name: topology
services.title: Topology and dependencies
services.scope: Accepted graph revisions, scoped Neo4j projection, service and agent graphs, impact, differences and reconciliation
services.authority: PostgreSQL owns accepted graph material; Neo4j is a verified query projection

services.name: assessment
services.title: Assessment and learning
services.scope: Fixed analysis cases, deterministic evaluations, observed risk, recommendations, forecasts and learning proposals
services.authority: Observed facts remain distinct from future prediction and proposed adaptations

services.name: knowledge
services.title: Knowledge and retrieval
services.scope: Knowledge source/version review, purpose and classification rules, bounded retrieval and immutable citations
services.authority: Approved supplied knowledge and exact excerpt provenance

services.name: agent-orchestration
services.title: Advisory agent orchestration
services.scope: Attributable agent-case seals, bounded multi-agent runs, one-time assignments, outputs, dissent and human arbitration
services.authority: A0 A1 A2 advisory assistance; no cloud execution authority

services.name: decision-governance
services.title: Decision governance
services.scope: Signed authorization-policy lifecycle, durable policy evaluation, approvals, one-time authorizations, fences, decision envelopes and replay
services.authority: Authoritative action permission, cancellation and bounded decision-context receipts

services.name: execution
services.title: Execution and workload control
services.scope: Provider plan translation, durable workflows, protected agent execution, control generations, checkpoints, compensation and isolated action dispatch
services.authority: Exactly attributable attempts; ambiguous external effects remain unknown until reconciled

services.name: recovery-assurance
services.title: Recovery assurance and validation
services.scope: Validation plan/probe lifecycle, resilience experiments, recovery paths, path certification and independence baselines
services.authority: Independent observed recovery validation; topology alone never certifies recovery

services.name: commercial-billing
services.title: Commercial and billing
services.scope: Customer qualifications, pilots, approved product claims, launch gates, subscriptions, metering, rating, invoices, payment reconciliation and value review
services.authority: Immutable admitted usage and money ledger; entitlements never increase operational authority

services.name: audit-reporting
services.title: Audit reporting and notifications
services.scope: Domain audit receipt aggregation, evidence-bundle export, recent activity, findings routing and notification delivery
services.authority: Read models and sealed exports preserve source ownership and current disclosure

services.name: experience-api
services.title: Unified experience API
services.scope: One browser application, backend for frontend, journey composition, saved views and personal preferences
services.authority: Uses domain APIs; no cross-service SQL or independent action permissions

services.name: edge-gateway
services.title: API edge
services.scope: External route compatibility, limits, TLS ingress and command routing
services.authority: Routes and authenticates transport; each owner still authorizes its operation
